tasks.subject: Task 2: Pinning, node TLS certificates, peer auth message
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Go helpers for SPKI pins and pinned TLS dialing; `otter-admin node add` creates a self-signed

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test ./internal/pinning/ ./internal/keys/ ./internal/admin/ ./internal/vectors/ -v`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`pinning.SPKIPin(cert)` = SHA-256(`RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo`)", "`pinning.ClientConfig(host, pins)`: with pins → accepts only a leaf whose pin matches, checks validity dates and hostname (SAN DNS or IP), ignores the CA chain; without pins → normal system verification", "`pinning.GenerateCert(hosts, ips, validity)` → ECDSA P-256 self-signed cert (SAN = hosts + ips), PEM cert + PEM key + pin", "`keys.PeerAuthMessage(id, nonce, ts)` = `\"otter-peer-v1\" ‖ id ‖ nonce ‖ be64(ts)`", "`node add`: default `--wss-port 27443`; repeatable `--ip`; for `WSS` endpoints writes `nodes/<label>/tls.crt` + `tls.key` (0600) valid 10 years and sets `tls_spki_pins`; IPs stored in `nodes/<label>/meta.json`; `--plain` endpoints get no cert", "Vectors: `tls_cert_der_hex` + `tls_spki_pin_hex` from a committed DER file", "Tests: matching pin connects (httptest TLS server with generated cert), wrong pin fails, wrong hostname fails, expired cert fails"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Replication package
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Authenticated peer sessions that exchange oplogs both ways with flow control, cursors, tie-breaking and redial.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test -race ./internal/replication/ -v`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Acceptor (`Replicator.ServeHTTP` on `<path>/peer`): sends `PeerHello`; verifies `PeerAuth` (node in manifest, not self, |skew| ≤ 5 min, signature over", "Dialer verifies `hello.node_id` == expected and the `PeerAuthOk` signature with the manifest key of that node", "Session: both sides send `PeerSubscribe{stored cursor}`; sender streams `Store.Since` in batches ≤512 records and ≤4 MiB, at most 4 unacked,", "Registry: one session per peer; if a second one appears, both nodes keep the session whose **dialer has the lower node_id** (same direction → newest)", "Replicator `Run`: every 5 s dial each manifest node without a session (WSS with pins; `WS_PLAIN` only if `allow_plain`), per-node backoff 5 s → 5 min", "`Dialer` is an interface (`Dial(ctx, *pb.NodeInfo) (*websocket.Conn, error)`) so tests can inject partitions", "`Status()` → per peer: connected, caught up, cursor (used by tests now, `otter-node status` in M8)", "Unit tests: two nodes over `httptest` converge both directions; bad signature / unknown node rejected; tie-break keeps one session; ErrRetryLater"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 12: Endpoint racing (`NodeSelector`) and connection manager
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Connect to the fastest working endpoint; remember what worked; move on fast when a node fails.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:network:test :core:data:testDebugUnitTest`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RpcClient reader never blocks on event handling (unbounded event channel); test with a slow collector", "Order: candidates with a success in the last 7 days first (by RTT ascending), then never-tried (by priority, manifest order), then those that failed in the last 10 minutes", "Race: start candidate 0, then one more every 250 ms, max 4 in flight; first to complete transport + `hello` (10 s timeout) wins; others cancelled/closed;", "ConnectionManager: race → `onConnected` (login…); if `onConnected` throws (e.g. `RETRY_LATER` because the node lacks our account yet), record a failure for", "`ConnectionState.Online(api, url, nodeLabel)`; `reconnect()` (drop + race now) and `retryNow()`", "`RemoteNodeApi.hello()` returns the `Hello` (node id, manifest version)", "Tests with `FakeTransport` + virtual time: slow first candidate loses to fast second; failing first → second wins without backoff; login failure on the winner → next candidate; stats ordering"]}
```
